posts.name: JimmyTheCannon
posts.cooked:
Got a Mint but it was VERY close. Terraforming only came out when there was 1 Environment card out at a time, so it wasn't too bad. Sedative Flechettes and Technological Singularity hurt quite a bit. The first Electro-Pulse Explosive blew itself up thanks to Synaptic Interruption; the second one came out after the Flechettes and Singularity, and everyone was *very* hurt. I managed to take it out, but just barely.

Tempest did the lion's share of the damage. Omnitron-X mostly kept components in play so Cosmitron wouldn't flip, and Time Shifted Unity, although not terribly effectively. Tachyon managed a decent Lightspeed Barrage and her other card that feeds on Burst cards (I forget the name) to clear out Omnitron's repair bots and do some damage to the environment cards. At that point there was an Explosives Wagon, Stout Barrel, Prickly Cactus, and Matthew Hayes in play, so I had to take out some of the cover in order to be able to hit Hayes (not that it ended up mattering). Switched to timeshifting Tempest and got a Lightning Slash and a Reclaim from the Deep; thankfully, it *didn't* play his environment destruction card when just the Barrel and Wagon were out, because that would have hurt.

 

Bunker was getting a decent setup initially before his equipment was blown up; switched to Upgrade Mode and got a bunch of cards in hand, then layed down Flak Cannon and starting doing some damage. When the second Electro Pulse came out I added Turret Mode for the extra damage; after that he stayed in Turret Mode, shooting Cosmitron for 5 damage per turn thanks to that and the Explosives Wagon.

Tempest got Genebound Shackles out twice after the first one was blown up, and a Lightning Field towards the end plus his base power had him hitting Cosmitron for 8 each turn and everything else for 4.

Unity got a lone Raptor Bot out, followed by a Platform Bot; they didn't last long (Sedative Flechettes). A Hasty Augmentation on Bunker worked well, though.

The last two turns were desperate. Everyone was between 6 and 12 damage when the second Electro Pulse came out; I had to scramble to take it out, and then Hayes was played. He killed the lone bot Unity had out at the time. I was whittling Cosmitron down and Tachyon got another Synaptic out, which turned Hayes from killing one of my heroes to shooting Cosmitron. Finished it off that round, and it couldn't have happened soon enough.
